The Statue of Lenin, a towering monument standing at over five meters tall, is the centerpiece of Hanoi's Lenin Park, located at 28A Dien Bien Phu Street in Ba Dinh District. This park, originally known as Canh Nong Garden during French colonial rule, was later renamed Chi Lang Garden before finally adopting its current name in honor of the Russian revolutionary leader Vladimir Ilyich Ulyanov, better known as Lenin, on October 7, 2003.
